headline: There is a massive opportunity over the next few years for people who know how to take messy real-world workflows and adapt foundation models to them. Doing that requires understanding how work gets done, designing evals, improving models through post-training, and building the feedback loops that continuously improve models. That’s how a general-purpose model becomes exceptional for a specific domain. Today, that skillset is still concentrated in a handful of labs.
